button.label: Insert Equation
button.supertip: Opens the fast popup EqnTide to insert a new equation at current cursor position.

button.label: Edit Equation
button.supertip: Reads the selected equation (OMML, Legacy MathType, or Modern MathType) and opens it in the editor.
Converts selected $...$ or \[...\] text into a native equation, or selected equation into LaTeX text.

button.label: Upgrade MathType
button.supertip: Opens the Upgrade Taskpane or directly upgrades all legacy MathType equations in this document.

button.label: Batch Converter
button.supertip: Launches the desktop batch document converter for bulk .docx processing or upgrades the current document on disk.
